en.name: Vegan cheddar-style cheese
en.summary: Vegan cheddar is usually a block of starch and coconut or other vegetable oil, coloured and flavoured to read as cheddar. Sealed, it keeps about 4 months in the fridge; once opened it is much shorter-lived than dairy cheddar — 3–7 days.
en.pantry: This is a refrigerated product, sealed or not, and the cupboard is not an option. It looks like a hard cheese but it is not one: there is no ripening, no salt-and-acid maturation and no low-moisture paste doing the preserving, just starch and fat held together, which is a moist and hospitable mixture. Follow the 2-hour rule when it is out, or 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Grate it cold; it smears at room temperature.
en.fridge: Unopened, it keeps about 4 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, or to the printed date if that comes first. Once opened, use it within 3–7 days — a far shorter window than the one dairy cheddar gets, and the single most useful thing to know about this product. Wrap the cut face airtight, keep it on an inside shelf, and check for surface mould each time you take it out. Buy a block rather than pre-grated if you use it slowly: the grated kind has far more surface area and goes over sooner.
en.freezer: There is no published freezer timeline for vegan cheddar. Many brands do freeze acceptably, especially grated, but starch-set cheeses thaw softer and sometimes weep, and the melt can turn gluey. If you are going to try it, grate the block first, bag it flat at −18 °C (0 °F), label the date and use it only in cooking. The unopened block lasts months in the fridge anyway, so freezing is rarely the problem worth solving.
en.thawing: Use grated vegan cheese straight from the freezer in a cooked dish. If you thaw a block, do it wrapped in the fridge, use it the same day, and do not refreeze it.
spoilage: Mould of any colour on the cut face or inside the wrapper.
A sour, yeasty or fermented smell — starch and oil do sour.
A slimy or wet surface, or liquid pooling in the pack.
A rancid, paint-like note from the oil, or a bitter taste.
tips: Note the opening date on the pack; the opened window is short.
Buy blocks rather than pre-grated if you use it slowly.
Wrap the cut face airtight, not loosely like a dairy cheese.
Grate it straight from the fridge — it smears when warm.

faq.q: How long does vegan cheese last once opened?
faq.a: About 3–7 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below — much shorter than dairy cheddar. Unopened, about 4 months.

faq.q: Why does vegan cheese go off faster than dairy cheddar?
faq.a: Dairy cheddar is preserved by ripening, salt, acid and low moisture. A starch-and-oil block has none of that once it is cut.
There is no published timeline. Grated, it usually works for cooking at −18 °C, but it thaws softer and can melt gluey.

faq.q: Does vegan cheese need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Yes, always, opened or not. It is a moist product with nothing preserving it beyond the seal and the cold.

zh.name: 純素切達風味起司
zh.summary: 純素切達通常是用澱粉加椰子油或其他植物油做成的塊狀品，再調色調味成切達的樣子。未開封冷藏約 4 個月；開封後能放的時間比真正的切達短得多——3～7 天。
zh.pantry: 不論開封與否，這都是冷藏產品，沒有櫥櫃這個選項。它看起來像硬質乳酪，但它不是：沒有熟成、沒有鹽與酸的長時間作用、也沒有低含水量的緻密結構在做保存工作，只有澱粉和油脂被黏在一起，那是一個潮濕又好客的混合物。離開冰箱後守 2 小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。要刨絲請趁冰的時候，回溫後會糊在刨刀上。
zh.fridge: 未開封在 4 °C 以下約 4 個月，或以包裝日期為準（取先到者）。開封後請在 3～7 天內用完——這個窗口比真正的切達短得多，也是關於這個產品最值得知道的一件事。切面要密封包好、放內側層架，每次拿出來都檢查表面有沒有長霉。如果你用得慢，請買整塊而不是刨好的絲：刨絲的表面積大得多，壞得也快。
zh.freezer: 純素切達沒有公告的冷凍期限。不少品牌冷凍表現可以接受，刨絲的尤其如此，但澱粉凝固型的起司解凍後會偏軟、有時出水，融化時也可能變得黏糊。真要嘗試，請先把整塊刨絲、壓平裝袋放 −18 °C，標上日期，並只用於料理。反正未開封的整塊在冷藏本來就能放好幾個月，冷凍很少是真正需要解決的問題。
zh.thawing: 刨絲的直接從冷凍下鍋。整塊若要解凍，請連包裝放冷藏、當天用完，不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 切面或包裝內出現任何顏色的霉。
聞起來發酸、有酵母味或發酵味——澱粉和油脂也會酸敗。
表面黏滑，或包裝內積出液體。
油脂出現油耗、油漆般的氣味，或吃起來發苦。
tips: 在包裝上寫開封日期；開封後的期限很短。
用得慢就買整塊，不要買刨好的絲。
切面要密封包好，不要像真乳酪那樣鬆包。
直接從冰箱拿出來刨絲——回溫後會糊掉。

faq.q: 純素起司開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 4 °C 以下約 3～7 天，比真正的切達短得多。未開封約 4 個月。

faq.q: 純素起司為什麼比切達壞得快？
faq.a: 切達靠熟成、鹽、酸和低含水量保存自己。澱粉加油脂的塊狀品切開後，這些條件一個都沒有。
沒有公告期限。刨絲後在 −18 °C 冷凍通常可以用於料理，但解凍後偏軟、融化時可能變黏糊。
一定要，不論開封與否。它含水量高，除了密封和低溫之外沒有任何保存機制。
